def VTask.replaceVertex {V : Type u_1} (G : SimpleGraph V) (s t : V) [DecidableEq V] : SimpleGraph V where
  adj v w := if v = t then
              if w = t then
                False
              else
                G.Adj s w
            else if w = t then
              G.Adj s v
            else
              G.Adj v w
  symmetry := by
    intro v w
    byCases hvt : v = t
    byCases hwt : w = t
    · -- v = t, w = t
      simp [adj, hvt, hwt]
      rfl
    · -- v = t, w ≠ t
      simp [adj, hvt, hwt]
      rfl
    · -- v ≠ t, w = t
      simp [adj, hvt, hwt]
      rfl
    · -- v ≠ t, w ≠ t
      simp [adj, hvt, hwt]
      exact G.symmetry v w
  loopless := by
    intro v
    byCases hvt : v = t
    · -- v = t
      simp [adj, hvt]
      trivial
    · -- v ≠ t
      simp [adj, hvt]
      exact G.loopless v
